name: Bring list
summary: A potluck list: each person claims one thing to bring, doubles are flagged and fixed, gaps stand out until the table is covered.
useWhen: a potluck, BYOB party or picnic where each guest brings one thing
'what should I bring', 'two people said chips', 'who's got ice'
dontUseWhen: one person shops for everything (use list)

by.description: Names already bringing it, as in the chat

suggested.description: true for a thing Muse proposes that nobody in the chat said; leave out for things the chat named
